"The Digital Personal Data Protection Bill, 2023, which is the revised version of the bill which was put up for public consultation earlier, has been approved by the cabinet on 5th July 2023. This is a historic moment as it is the first Act of the Parliament of India where "she/her" pronouns were used unlike the usual "he/him" pronouns. The bill aims to provide protection of the personal data of individuals, to create a framework for processing, storage, and transfer of such data, and to establish a Data Protection Authority for the purpose. The bill is a dynamic and evolving document, and inclusive language has been used to ensure that it is accessible and relevant to all. Additions and refinements will continue to be made over time.
